tail_policy: Hold altitude through50s; yaw ramps down48-50s. No landing or ground-contact model added.
phase_policy: Roll and full-amplitude yaw pressure waveforms are shifted2s relative to the40s case, preserving main-window phase. Yaw starts smoothly8-10s; final heading need not be zero.
model_boundary: Ground-coordinate initial position with existing hover-trim rotor speed; no arming, spool-up, contact or ground effect.
engineering_check_policy: New single-run reporting criteria fixed before execution, applied to estimate and truth separately; not changes to old protocols or a flight-clearance claim.
failure_policy: One simulation only. Preserve failures and any completed MAT; no parameter retry or formal batch. Stop continuation if takeoff, estimator, aero, finite-state or thrust/tilt saturation checks fail.
